title: reader admin server has no rate limiting; transit admin does
description: transit/src/admin.rs has RateLimiter (token-bucket, default 60 rpm per IP). reader/src/admin.rs has no rate limiting at all. An attacker or misbehaving script on the local machine can hammer the reader admin endpoint without backpressure. Loopback-only means this is low risk, but the asymmetry will generate a class of 'why doesn't reader have X that transit has' PRs. Both should share the same admin security posture.
